content: Please note that we have added back shake into CI. I suggest merging main on any currently open PRs. The flags we use (consistent with Mathlib) are lake shake --add-public --keep-implied --keep-prefix.
Sorry, could we remove it again? It is giving disastrously bad results on cslib#376, which will only be fixable by upstream changes to shake, I think. (It doesn't seem to understand Std.Do properly.)
(Note that Mathlib has not yet re-adopted shake into CI; I'd suggest waiting until we get that working.)
It gave me a hilarious suggestion to import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum to use linarith instead of Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
Which I had to adopt to pass CI

Kim Morrison said:

(Note that Mathlib has not yet re-adopted shake into CI; I'd suggest waiting until we get that working.)

Sorry about that! I think I misunderstood an earlier conversation to mean it was already back in Mathlib. cslib#397 to remove again.
(I've set to automerge so that you can merge and get this for 376 whenever you'd like)

Could someone confirm if it is still the case that shake is disabled in Mathlib? I've tried to keep up with this and still see this commented out step, but I wasn't sure if maybe this change would appear somewhere else with the new mathlib-ci repo.
